lead: Community votes, with a quorum and a deadline. The result only shows when the deadline ends.
soMembros: Votes belong to the people in the community. Join the community to see them and vote.
vazioMod: No votes yet. Open the first one when the community needs to decide something together.

cartao.confirmarAberta: Your name will appear next to this vote when the vote closes. Vote for “{opcao}”?
cartao.avisoAberta: Open ballot: when it closes, everyone in the community sees each person's name next to their vote.
cartao.votei: Your vote was counted. It can no longer change.
cartao.resultadoDepois: The result shows when the deadline ends.
cartao.chegouDepois: You joined the community after this vote opened. It belongs to those who were already here.
cartao.naoMembro: Only people in the community vote.
cartao.empate: Tie between the most voted options.
cartao.votantesPoucos: Fewer than 3 people voted: no result.
cartao.semNumeros: The numbers are not shown: one option got fewer than 3 votes, and its count could be worked out from the others.
cartao.quorumNao: The quorum was not reached: the vote is not valid and the result does not show.
cartao.cancelarPergunta: Cancel this vote? The votes cast disappear and the result never shows.
cartao.cancelada: Vote cancelled by the moderators. The votes were deleted.
cartao.comoTexto: Who voted and what they voted are stored separately, with nothing linking one to the other, and the ballots are mixed at every vote. Not even the moderators see anyone's vote. Ballots are only counted when the deadline ends, and the result shows totals: no number below 3.
cartao.regraVoto: Only people who were already in the community when the vote opened can vote. A vote cannot change once cast.

nova.perguntaDica: E.g.: Which day do we hold the work day?
nova.explicacaoDica: What the community needs to know to vote.
nova.secretaDica: Nobody knows anyone's vote, not even the moderators. At the end, only the totals.
nova.abertaDica: Each person's name appears next to their vote when the vote closes. The screen warns before each vote.
nova.quorumDica: How many people need to vote for the result to count (3 or more).
nova.prazoDica: From 1 hour to 60 days. Nobody closes it earlier.
nova.naoMuda: Once open, the vote does not change: not the question, the options or the mode. It can be cancelled.

numeros.lead: Only for moderators. Totals per week, with nobody's name. Numbers below 3 show as “fewer than 3”.
numeros.notaTempo: Time to decide: the median between the report and the first recorded decision, when there are 3 decisions or more in the week.
numeros.notaMembros: Joined: people who joined during the week and are still in the community.

erros.sem_permissao: Only the community's moderators can do this.
erros.ja_votou: You have already voted on this.
erros.muitas_abertas: The community already has 5 open votes. Wait for one to close.
erros.muitos_pedidos: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a little and try again.
erros.sem_conexao: No connection. Check the internet and try again.
erros.explicacao: The context can have up to 1000 characters.
erros.opcoes: 2 to 8 options, no repeats, up to 120 characters each.
erros.quorum: The quorum goes from 3 to 100000 people.
erros.prazo: The deadline goes from 1 hour to 60 days from now.
